proposals.title: Per-user view-only access for sales orders and inventory
proposals.executiveSummary: Introduce a supported per-user role that can view sales orders and inventory without creating orders, invoicing, editing records, or receiving purchaser capabilities.
proposals.problem: Existing standard roles do not provide the requested combination of sales-order and inventory visibility without edit, invoicing, order-entry, or purchaser access. The available view-only-style option applies at organisation level and is not fully refined.
proposals.impact: Organisations cannot safely give an individual user the requested operational visibility without also granting unwanted capabilities or applying a broader organisation-level setting.
proposals.scope: First version: add a per-user view-only permission profile for sales orders and inventory; block create, edit, delete, invoice, and purchasing actions in both the interface and server-side authorization; define treatment of financial information; and test common direct-link and API authorization paths. Non-goals: a general custom-role builder, field-level permissions, organisation-wide workflow changes, or view-only access to modules beyond sales orders and inventory.
proposals.risks: Permissions may be enforced inconsistently across screens, actions, exports, and APIs. Sales orders and inventory may expose financial information that requires a product decision. Existing role assumptions could cause regressions.
proposals.questions: Which sales-order and inventory fields may the role view?,Should cost, margin, pricing, and other financial information be hidden?,Should view-only users be allowed to search, export, print, or download documents?,Should the role see all records or only records assigned to the user?,Does the existing organisation-level option need migration or coexistence behavior?
proposals.priority: medium — the requested access control addresses an identified permissions gap, but the ticket contains one customer request and no stated deadline or operational incident.
proposals.estimateAssumptions: This independent scenario assumes approval and one developer's capacity are available from the estimated start date. The range includes permission design, server-side and interface enforcement, automated and manual regression testing, security review, code review, and release review. Technical unknowns include existing role architecture, financial-data boundaries, exports, document access, API enforcement, and interaction with the organisation-level option. Dependencies on security and product decisions, test coverage, migration requirements, or release scheduling could move the dates.

proposals.executiveSummary: VacMotion Ltd wants the customer-specific invoice due date/payment terms shown as soon as a customer is selected while creating or editing a quote or sale. The proposed first version will expose the resolved terms in the sale header and allow authorised users to adjust them under existing or new permission controls. This removes the repeated trip to Customers > Edit > Sales and lets the salesperson confirm the terms during the customer conversation. Automatic selection of a Xero branding theme should remain a separately scoped option until Peter confirms the data ownership and integration constraints.
proposals.problem: The quote and sale workflow does not show the selected customer’s invoice due date/payment terms. proposals.impact: VacMotion reports performing this lookup for every new quote or sale. The repeated navigation wastes sales time and creates a risk that the salesperson selects branding or discusses payment expectations without seeing the customer’s actual terms.
proposals.scope: Display the selected customer’s resolved invoice due date/payment terms in the quote and sale header, with permission-controlled editing where the product rules allow it. The first version should load the customer override or default when the customer is selected, refresh it safely when the customer changes, preserve authorised intentional edits, and cover create/edit flows with regression tests. Automatic Xero branding-theme selection, a broader Customer Group policy model, changes to invoice due-date calculation rules, and bulk updates to customer records are not included.

proposals.impact: Obsolete suppliers clutter operational lists and can be selected unintentionally. In this ticket, continued display also has a personal impact because one supplier represents an individual who has died.
proposals.scope: Allow an authorised user to mark a supplier inactive or active without deleting its record or purchase-order history.
